records.body:
다음 지문을 토대로 직독직해 교육 방법을 실천해 보세요.
Coming of age in the 18th and 19th centuries, the personal diary became
a centerpiece in the construction of a modern subjectivity, at the heart
of which is the application of reason and critique to the understanding of
world and self, which allowed the creation of a new kind of knowledge.
(후략)
